coverage: Fifteen provinces and the Isla de la Juventud special municipality, with 168 municipalities. Boundaries retain the 2017 source geography, valid in the retained 2023 release; the source excludes the Guantánamo naval-base footprint. Province statistics use ONEI’s calculated effective population at 31 December 2024, rather than obsolete legacy projections. Effective population is a residence-based statistical measure, not a new census. Municipal populations are not inferred from province totals. All levels dissolve from common land partitions. Only shared internal boundaries and the Haiti–Dominican Republic land frontier have lines; coastlines and ocean gaps have no stroke. Country overview pages remain hidden.
processing: Full available source resolution retained, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places. Shared internal edges stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Deeper geometry loads only for the selected region. All views use the shared regional renderer, selected-outline index, adaptive detail, lifecycle and three-country cache. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Territory context features carry their own destination bounds.
